y2f22b062f95.add: - **Heat flow direction** depends only on **temperature** – from hotter to colder body.

yb39e7b3391f.add: - **Isobaric** = constant pressure (blowing air through an open pipe, heating water in an open pan).

yf313c897a82.add: - **Adiabatic** = no heat exchange (sudden **tyre burst**, rapid compression); isothermal = constant temperature.

yffb6be9d9ab.add: - **Sublimation** separates **iodine** (also camphor, NH4Cl, naphthalene) from non-subliming solids such as KCl or sand.

y64d1f8566e4.add: - **Sublime (solid → gas):** **dry ice**, **camphor**, iodine, naphthalene; ice melts, it does not sublime.

y6de9671897b.add: - **Oil, soap or detergent** on water **lowers its surface tension** considerably.

y00f92a4eea9.add: - **Stomata** = leaf pores for gas exchange and transpiration, each enclosed by two **kidney-shaped guard cells**.

y5359a3ddf1a.add: - **Transpiration pull** from the leaves is the main force lifting water up the xylem against gravity.

yeaa2eb34d4e.add: - **Dispersion** = splitting of white light into colours by a prism (rainbow = dispersion + total internal reflection).

y457f83e69bb.add: - **Thin-film interference** gives colours of **soap bubbles** and oil films.

yb6e50a27bde.add: - **Guttation** = loss of excess water as **liquid droplets** from leaf tips/margins (transpiration = vapour).

y21be6ee0dc4.add: - **Floating or sinking** depends on the **difference in densities** of object and liquid (floats if its density is lower).

yc20158b1ece.add: - **Bulbs on the same supply (parallel):** P = V²/R, so the **dimmer bulb has the higher resistance** (in series the reverse).

ye058d417365.add: - **Surface tension** makes drops **spherical** (least surface area for a volume).

yea964ea7ad4.add: - **Thermal capacity** = mass × specific heat – depends on **mass** (and material), not shape or temperature.

y0e8b1bffecb.add: - **Sitting near a fan:** moving air **evaporates sweat**, taking latent heat from the skin.

yc18674c10d7.add: - **Curie point:** temperature above which a ferromagnetic metal **loses its magnetism** (iron ~770 °C).

y276b5ba5a15.add: - **Specific gravity (relative density)** = density of substance ÷ density of **water at 4 °C**; measured by hydrometer.

ybf8e5beda8d.add: - **Water expands ~9% on freezing** – a full, sealed glass vessel in a freezer **breaks**; pipes burst in winter.

y5a5fbf227d2.add: - **Glycol** (ethylene glycol / its ethers) = **anti-freeze**; in aviation fuel it **prevents freezing** (icing).

ye2042166f9b.add: - **Magnesium sulphate (Epsom salt)** – mordant (assist) in **dyeing** and used in **leather tanning**; also laxative.

yf54bcc0a29e.add: - **Phenolphthalein:** colourless in acid and neutral, **pink in alkali**.

yf4773ae8217.add: - **Crest to next trough = half a wavelength**; crest to crest = one wavelength.

y23ab66020aa.add: - **Hooves** – ungulates (deer, zebra, horse, cattle); **jackal** (dog family) has clawed paws.

yf6f4e8434bf.add: - **'On the Origin of Species' (1859)** – written by **Charles Darwin**.

y140fa4a403b.add: - **No atmosphere → black sky** (no scattering; Moon, space); blue sky = Rayleigh scattering.

y4fd23fedba9.add: - **Solids:** definite shape, high density, rigidity and **negligible compressibility**.

yfec1da0285c.add: - **Thermal conductivity:** stainless steel < aluminium < copper (< silver – best).

yfeea1212701.add: - **Carbon compounds treated as inorganic:** **cyanides**, carbonates, oxides of carbon, carbides.
